svg.title: The reconstructed classifier sweep examines transcripts
svg.desc: Keep classifier passes and transcript inputs visibly reconstructed and separately counted by lettering. Analysis machinery is a method view, not raw incident evidence. Place the evidence-lane wall behind the foreground review work, marking the on-premises setting without asserting complete access.

**Caption:**
> METR SEARCHED ITS REVIEWED TRANSCRIPT DATASET.
